text: The KFS Comprehensive and Sectoral Implementation Plans for Landslide Prevention is an initiative led by the Korea Forest Service to mitigate landslide risks in the Republic of Korea. It involves cross-ministerial integration of slope-risk data into a national Digital Slope Integrated Landslide Information System, upgrading landslide early warning systems, expanding management to residential areas, and establishing a Digital Landslide Response Team. The initiative aligns with the National Forest Plan's disaster prevention and public safety objectives.
